class.name: InputIconServer
class.brief_description: Returns the icon of an input event from one [InputIconSet] per device family.

method.name: get_device_family
method.description: Returns the family of a connected joypad from its name and vendor id ([method Input.get_joy_name], [method Input.get_joy_info]). Returns [constant INPUT_ICON_FAMILY_GENERIC_GAMEPAD] if the joypad is unknown or not connected.

method.name: get_event_family
method.description: Returns the family [method get_icon] uses for [param event] with [constant INPUT_ICON_FAMILY_AUTO].

method.name: get_family_for_joy_name
method.description: Returns the family of a joypad name and USB vendor id. The vendor ids of Microsoft ([code]0x045E[/code]), Sony ([code]0x054C[/code]) and Nintendo ([code]0x057E[/code]) decide first, also as hex text in the name (the [code]Gamepad.id[/code] of browsers, for example [code]"054c-0ce6-Wireless Controller"[/code]); then names such as [code]Xbox[/code], [code]XInput[/code], [code]PS5[/code], [code]DualSense[/code], [code]Nintendo[/code] or [code]Joy-Con[/code]. Returns [constant INPUT_ICON_FAMILY_GENERIC_GAMEPAD] for other names.

method.name: get_icon
method.description: Returns the icon of [param event]. With [constant INPUT_ICON_FAMILY_AUTO], the family is chosen as described in the class description. The lookup order is: the icon of the event in the family's set, the icon in the [constant INPUT_ICON_FAMILY_GENERIC_GAMEPAD] set (for the Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo families), the fallback icon of the event type in the same order. Returns [code]null[/code] if no set has an icon.

method.name: get_icon_for_text
method.description: Like [method get_icon] for the event of a text form of [method InputAction.text_to_event], for example [code]"Gamepad:A"[/code] or [code]"Keyboard:Space"[/code].

method.name: get_icon_set
method.description: Returns the set of a family: the set of [method set_icon_set], else the set of the project setting [code]input_devices/icons/<family>[/code], else [code]null[/code].

method.name: has_icon_set_override
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the family's set was set with [method set_icon_set] and the project setting is ignored.

method.name: reset_icon_set
method.description: Drops the set of [method set_icon_set]; the project setting applies again. Emits [signal icon_set_changed].

method.name: set_icon_set
method.description: Sets the set of a family at runtime, in place of the project setting. [code]null[/code] means no set for this family; use [method reset_icon_set] to return to the project setting. Emits [signal icon_set_changed].

members.member: If not [constant INPUT_ICON_FAMILY_AUTO], all gamepad events use this family, for example when the player chooses "PlayStation prompts" in the options.

signal.name: icon_set_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the set of [param family] was replaced or reset, when its project setting changed, or when the set itself changed (for example when it is edited in the Inspector). Prompts should look up their icons again. When [member gamepad_family] changes, it is emitted with [constant INPUT_ICON_FAMILY_GENERIC_GAMEPAD].

constants.constant: Chooses the family from the event and its device.
Icons for keys and mouse buttons.
Icons for gamepads of unknown make; also the second choice for the other gamepad families.
Icons for Xbox and XInput gamepads.
Icons for Nintendo gamepads (Switch Pro Controller, Joy-Con).
